title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 410 Dakota Avenue South in Huron, South Dakota, as the "First Lieutenant Thomas Michael Martin Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 410 Dakota Avenue South in Huron, South Dakota, as the First Lieutenant Thomas Michael Martin Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A law renames a Huron, South Dakota post office building after First Lieutenant Thomas Michael Martin.
summary.what_it_does: This act names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 410 Dakota Avenue South in Huron, South Dakota, the First Lieutenant Thomas Michael Martin Post Office Building. It changes only the name used for the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on November 25, 2024.
